from sklearn.datasets import load_digits
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

X, y = load_digits(return_X_y=True)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)

net = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(),
                    MLPClassifier(hidden_layer_sizes=(32,), max_iter=500, random_state=42))
net.fit(X_train, y_train)

mlp = net[-1]
n_params = sum(w.size for w in mlp.coefs_) + sum(b.size for b in mlp.intercepts_)
epochs = mlp.n_iter_
test_acc = net.score(X_test, y_test)
print(n_params, epochs, round(test_acc, 3))

checks.test: tuple(net[-1].hidden_layer_sizes) == (32,) and [w.shape for w in net[-1].coefs_] == [(64, 32), (32, 10)]
n_params is not None and int(n_params) == 64 * 32 + 32 + 32 * 10 + 10
epochs is not None and int(epochs) == net[-1].n_iter_ and net[-1].loss_curve_[-1] < net[-1].loss_curve_[0]
test_acc is not None and 0.95 < float(test_acc) <= 1.0
